name: 01-prompt-names
description: getPromptNames (prompt-converters.js:49-58) builds the PromptNames object a request carries, and its startsWithGroupName predicate is the helper every converter uses to decide whether a group member's name is already prefixed. Note the exact spelling it tests for: `name + ': '` (colon AND space), so a message starting with `Seraphina:` without the space does not count.
